2124979049558892818.en_summary: Trump made $635 million in royalties from his $TRUMP meme coin last year, even as the coin’s price collapsed, per The Wall Street Journal. The figure from Trump’s annual financial disclosure. Coin launched three days before second inauguration, peaked ~$74 within a day, now down roughly 98-99% from peak. Part of about $1.4 billion from crypto ventures in 2025, largest share of ~$2.2 billion total income, including >$500 million from World Liberty Financial. Trump hosted dinner Sunday for top holders, guests including Floyd Mayweather and Kevin O’Leary.
2124979049558892818.zh_summary: Trump 去年從其 $TRUMP 迷因幣獲得 6.35 億美元版稅，即使幣價崩盤，據《華爾街日報》報導。數字來自 Trump 年度財務披露。幣在第二次就職三天前推出，一天內峰值約 $74，現已從峰值下跌約 98-99%。是 2025 年加密貨幣業務約 14 億美元的一部分，佔披露總收入約 22 億美元的最大份額，包括來自 World Liberty Financial 的超過 5 億美元。Trump 週日為頂級持有者舉辦晚宴，嘉賓包括 Floyd Mayweather 和 Kevin O’Leary。
